proposal.name: Publish complete modeled decisions with compact evidence links

plan.name: Publish complete modeled decisions with compact evidence links
plan.summary: Complete step 3 of parent #783 in one plumbing pull request: first try the existing modeled publication unchanged, then, with an explicitly configured dashboard URL and only when its complete comment exceeds maxComment or its marker cannot read back within maxMarker, publish one compact comment backed by the exact validated, completed saved result, using the same fallback for new and recovered proposals, revisions, amendments, questions and remaining options after partial choices. Compact comments retain every candidate statement's exact wording, kind and known-bug expectation, exact bounds and existing TLC check account, prior decisions and original commands; amendments also retain removal and change warnings for invariants, properties and fairness, old and new wording and checking-scope changes, while questions retain all remaining questions and options verbatim, each option's statements and checks, original preview choices and their unratified model-only qualification, and comparisons name the captured baseline and both scopes with the material view, model and scope qualifications. Draw every supported chart state, initial and labeled directed arrow with the existing literal escaping and generated aliases, retaining interpretable comparison additions, removals and legends and concise counts, but move occurrence tables, full comparison evidence, hidden steps and provenance to the exact saved-draft dashboard locator without changing any source, reader, preview, comparison, bounds, proposal hash or lock identity; keep the faithful limitation for explorations above 500 states and refuse non-actionably if indispensable text or charts still cannot fit, without clipping, splitting alternatives, raising limits or redrafting to reduce evidence. Add a documented watch -dashboard-url flag with no default: unset or explicitly empty keeps the existing non-actionable overflow refusal, so compact publication is enabled only by an explicitly configured dashboard address that serves this repository; validate each nonempty value as an absolute HTTP(S) base without credentials, query or fragment before starting work, and construct deterministic escaped links supporting a deployment path prefix without contacting the dashboard; save and finish the full record before an actionable post, reuse it after publication failure or restart, preserve references through answers, ratification, failed and resumed builds, and continue refusing missing, stale, swapped, corrupt or unresolved evidence while keeping small comments, legacy inline posts, plumbing plans, plans of issues and chart-free questions compatible. Update SPEC.md with [#911's ratified plan](.invariant/plans/issue-911.json), README.md within its 400-line limit, and docs/statecharts.md, docs/dashboard.md and docs/factory.md to describe compact publication, durable evidence and installation-specific dashboard configuration requiring operators to pass the address of a dashboard that serves their repository, replace the blanket inline-or-refuse policy and change marker_capacity_603_regression_test.go's valid evidence overflow expectation when a dashboard URL is explicitly configured while preserving oversized mandatory wording, hostile-marker and failed-check refusals, run the repository's applicable unit and existing CI integration and affected real-tool checks without CI policy changes, and leave the explicitly requested compact-publication decision refining D-0345, D-0355, D-0362 and D-0387 to the merger because this build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestCompact911PublicationAndCompatibility
tests.says: With a dashboard explicitly configured, evidence-heavy 8-state/41-arrow, incompressible and over-4-MiB checked records publish once under both limits with complete mandatory text and topology, exact saved bytes and unchanged identities; without one overflow remains refused, small drafts retain their original bytes, and over-capacity models keep their faithful limitation.

tests.name: TestCompact911RecoveryRatificationAndBuild
tests.says: Publication failure and a fresh watcher reuse the completed record without redrafting; exact ratification writes the saved statements, bounds and sources, builds once and keeps the reference through failed and resumed posts.

tests.name: TestCompact911QuestionsAndComparisons
tests.says: Multiple forks with checked previews and a captured baseline remain complete in compact publication and partial-choice posts; restart, final choice and revision preserve original evidence and actual choices, never ratifying or building on a choice.

tests.name: TestCompact911AmendmentWarningsAndBaseline
tests.says: Compact amendments retain changed and removed statement warnings, unchanged candidate wording, both scopes and comparison qualifications, and retain their captured ratification across revision and recovery.

tests.name: TestCompact911RefusalsAndSaveOrdering
tests.says: Evidence-only overflow succeeds, but invalid readers, previews and comparisons and oversized indispensable wording or chart labels refuse without actionable partial content; failed Save or Finish cannot publish a usable decision.

tests.name: TestCompact911WatchDashboardURL
tests.says: The actual watcher advertises -dashboard-url with no default: omitted and explicitly empty values keep overflow refused, explicit addresses including a custom path prefix link recovered drafts to the exact saved result, and invalid nonempty bases fail before work, without running a drafting agent or dashboard.

tests.name: TestCompact911FactoryLinkReturnsFullDashboardRecord
tests.says: Follow a real factory-produced compact comment's evidence link through the dashboard locator and reader page to the exact complete saved JSON, retaining the authenticated reference, full sources and checked evidence.

usage.summary: Revised `plan.json` and acceptance tests so `-dashboard-url` has no default; unset or empty retains overflow refusal, while preserving the complete step. Check 1 passed: all seven acceptance tests fail on the base as required; `repo/` remains unchanged, and the eventual change requires a person to merge.
